settings.title: Settings
settings.cardDescription: Choose where and when your newsletters are sent
settings.emailHint: Your newsletters will be sent to this address
settings.deliveryModePerPodcastHint: Choose whether sources arrive immediately, in the daily newsletter or both under
settings.infoBullet1: • The daily newsletter arrives at your chosen time; sources set to “Immediately” arrive as separate emails
settings.infoBullet2: • You can use a different email address than your login email
settings.infoBullet3: • The delivery time is automatically converted to your local timezone
settings.infoBullet4: • Changes take effect with the next newsletter
settings.infoBullet5: • With several items, the daily newsletter starts with an overview that weighs podcasts most, then YouTube, then Website (RSS); the complete summaries follow
settings.styleSectionDescription: Applies to the individual summaries and to the overview at the top of the daily newsletter. Takes effect with the next newly created summary; existing summaries stay unchanged.
settings.toneAnalyticalDescription: Arguments, causes and consequences; names uncertainties.
settings.toneWarmDescription: Personal and friendly, without cutting content.
settings.promptAdditionPlaceholder: e.g. “Briefly explain technical terms” or “Focus on the impact on local government”
settings.promptAdditionHint: Refines style and perspective, at most {max} characters; line breaks become spaces. The addition adds no facts and does not override the rules on truthfulness, faithfulness to sources and safety.
settings.errorPromptAdditionTooLong: The addition can be at most {max} characters long.
settings.errorInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address

subscriptions.websiteInputDescription: Paste the RSS or Atom feed URL – or the website address if it advertises its feed. Only complete, publicly accessible text is summarized.

subscriptions.websiteContentModeEmpty: No articles in the feed yet
subscriptions.noSources: You haven't added any sources yet

aiEndpoints.title: AI endpoints
aiEndpoints.description: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint per purpose, optionally with a fallback. Without an endpoint the purpose is not set up – nothing is taken from the environment. Changes reach the worker within a minute.
aiEndpoints.apiKeyStored: Stored ({hint}) – leave empty to keep it
aiEndpoints.apiKeyNone: Optional – empty for servers without a key
aiEndpoints.apiKeyNote: The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
aiEndpoints.loadError: The stored endpoints could not be loaded: {error}
aiEndpoints.testModelMissing: Model “{model}” is not listed by the server.
aiEndpoints.testModelUnknown: The server does not return a model list.
aiEndpoints.error_field_baseUrl: Base URL: http(s) URL without credentials, query or fragment, e.g. http://192.168.0.20:8000/v1.
aiEndpoints.error_masterKeyMissing: AI_ENDPOINTS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set on the server – no key can be stored without it.
aiEndpoints.error_masterKeyInvalid: AI_ENDPOINTS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is invalid (32 bytes base64 expected).
aiEndpoints.error_redirect: The server redirects (HTTP {status}) – please enter the final base URL.
aiEndpoints.error_timeout: Timeout – the server does not respond within 10 seconds.
aiEndpoints.error_storedKeyUnreadable: The stored key cannot be decrypted (AI_ENDPOINTS_ENCRYPTION_KEY changed?). Please enter it again.
aiEndpoints.fallbackHint: Takes over automatically when the endpoint above fails (unreachable, HTTP error, model not found, empty answer). Without a fallback, the work is retried later.
aiEndpoints.fallbackRemoveConfirm: Delete the fallback for “{purpose}”? Failures will then have no replacement.
aiEndpoints.notConfiguredHint: No endpoint is stored for this purpose. Until one is saved, this work fails in the worker.
aiEndpoints.deleteConfirm: Delete the endpoint for “{purpose}”? Its fallback is deleted too, and the purpose is no longer set up.
aiEndpoints.error_primaryMissing: Please save the endpoint above first – a fallback needs an endpoint.
